fields.text: The Manor, Ravenholdt

<name>,

Ravenholdt has taken an interest in you, young thief. We have been watching. Your style is a bit awkward but nothing we couldn't fix.

Should you be prepared to embark on a career as a disciple of Master Ravenholdt and member of the Assassin's League, you have only to bring the Seal of Ravenholdt (attached to this letter) to Ravenholdt Manor.

Your first task is to find the manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad and demonstrate your cunning.

Regards,

Fahrad

Take the Seal of Ravenholdt to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad.

Your cunning will be tested along the way. Be prepared.

Did you meet Milton?

<Fahrad laughs.>

Most excellent, young thief.

You look a bit beaten down, but no worse for the wear.

A long journey awaits you - long and rewarding. Are you prepared to finally embrace your destiny among the masters of Ravenholdt?

Speak with the guards outside. They will get you started.
Syndicate Sabotage

Sometimes, <race>, a single cut in the right place will drop a foe dead. The same is often true of organizations.

Our agents have identified a key target among the ranks of the Syndicate: a man by the name of Lord Tomas.

He plays an instrumental role in the functions of Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you wish to be of service to Ravenholdt, go to Durnholde and eliminate him. The quicker, and quieter, the better.
Find Lord Tomas inside Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills, and kill him. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform.

With Tomas dead, Durnholde Keep will no doubt be destabilized. Lowly thugs of the Syndicate's kind often fall to disarray without a figurehead to lead them.

Good work, <name>. I may call upon you for future missions.
The Horn of Xelthos

<A note sits in the chest>

Hello, <name>.

I desire a treasure known as The Horn of Xelthos, which is somewhere within Shadowfang Keep.

Venturing inside the keep usually calls for backup. However, for this job, a low profile is of utmost importance.

You must go alone.

I have a contact, by the name of Veenix, in the Stonetalon Mountains. He should be able to help you get past the courtyard gate. The rest is up to you. 

Return the horn here, and your payment will be sent soon after.

- C
Find The Horn of Xelthos inside of Shadowfang Keep. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.
<The chest sits, empty.>
<You place The Horn of Xelthos into the chest>
The Horn of Xelthos
Description
Log

<A note sits in the chest>

For <name>. I'll be seeing you.

- C

Return the horn here, and your payment will be sent soon after.

You said you're breaking into Shadowfang...alone? You've got some guts! 

I can hook you up with explosives to get past the gate, but I'll need a work order to make it look legit on the books. One of the other Venture Co. guys around here's gotta be carrying one.

Nice job, <name>. I figure that was a cakewalk for someone in your line of work.

As promised, here's the goods.
